system.description:
Trained in the Opal Mages Guild Association (O.M.G.A.), founded by Jorhim Shadowstitch and led by Archmage Elnora Myrill since the War of Tariel. It trains the gifted in exchange for their loyalty.

  • Coordinated Casting: once per encounter, a creature in melee with one of your allies has Disadvantage on its save against your spell.
    • 9th level: twice per encounter.
  • Guild Standing: Advantage on Persuasion invoking the O.M.G.A.'s name with Opal's government or military, and on recalling the Guild's ranks and leaders.
